acceptance: For TPC-H and TPC-DS power tests, no call to get_query (or the dsqgen path) occurs between query_start and query_end: a unit test with a get_query stub that fails if called while the timer is open passes for both benchmarks and fails against the base commit.

Text equivalence: for a fixed seed and stream 0 at SF0.01, the SQL strings executed after the change are byte-identical to those executed on the base commit (golden comparison produced in the PR from the base commit's output).
get_query (or dsqgen) is invoked exactly once per query per power run: a test counts the calls with preflight enabled.
A generation failure aborts before any query timer starts (the existing preflight failure test passes unchanged).

Smoke: DuckDB TPC-H SF0.01 power run before and after on the same host; per-query timings pasted in the PR; the per-query total drops by about the generation cost (about 5 ms per query expected; do not assert equality).
The throughput path and its tests are unchanged: uv run -- pytest tests/unit/core/throughput tests/unit/core/tpch tests/unit/core/tpcds -k 'power or throughput' passes.

The owner's choice at the decision gate is quoted in context before the PR is armed, and bundles produced after the change are distinguishable from earlier ones by that mechanism (a test or a recorded check shows the distinguishing field or version value for a before/after pair).

Closing steps: (a) if the owner chose A, result-schema-2-4-producer-20261022 is updated to need this item and to drop query generation from its timer-scope bullet; (b) perf-smoke-rebaseline-after-power-query-generation-20261103 gets not_before set to the merge date plus 7 days, so it cannot turn ready before five nightly results exist.

description:
Problem. In the TPC-H power test (benchbox/core/tpch/power_test.py) query_start is taken before benchmark.get_query(...), which runs a qgen subprocess (tpch/queries.py) plus dialect translation; the TPC-DS power test (benchbox/core/tpcds/power_test.py) does the same with dsqgen. The throughput tests pregenerate text (tpch/throughput_test.py _resolve_query_text), so the two tests time different work. Measured on one macOS host: get_query takes a median 5.1 ms per query at steady state (first call 376 ms), against perf-smoke baseline queries of 4.4 to 12.3 ms, so power numbers carry roughly the generation cost per query and skew fast engines. It affects 22 of the 24 Power@Size terms for TPC-H and the corresponding TPC-DS terms.

Spec: TPC-H 3.0.1 clause 5.3.7.2 defines a query interval from submission of the query to the SUT; query generation by the driver precedes submission and is not part of it.

Also: _preflight_validate_generation in the TPC-H power test already calls get_query for every query in the permutation and discards the text, so generation runs twice per query. Generate once, keep the text, and execute that text.

Reconciliation with a recorded decision: the accepted locality ADR, amendment 'Round Trip Removed and Platform Timings' (item 6: timers measure only the query; adapters move tag setup, stats lookups, validation, plan capture and power-test query generation out of the measured timer; runs record run.timing_method and are compared and ranked within one method; published numbers change when the timer fix lands), and the open item result-schema-2-4-producer-20261022 already cover this scope. The ADR moved to the site repository in #3545; its pre-move text is docs/development/adr/adr-client-link-locality-disclosure.md at commit e4a8a09091^. This item is the query-generation slice of that work.

DECISION GATE (owner, before the PR is armed): how bundles produced after this change are told apart from earlier ones. (A, recommended) Land as the query-generation slice of timing method 2; timing_method stays unwritten by this item (the code reads it but no producer writes it; method 2 requires every scope in the ADR to be out of the timer), and separation until result-schema-2-4-producer lands relies on the BenchBox version recorded in the bundle plus the changelog; result-schema-2-4-producer then needs this item and drops query generation from its timer-scope bullet. (B) Add an interim marker field. (C) The owner supersedes ADR item 6 for this slice and accepts changelog-only separation. Only the owner chooses; quote the choice in context. Implementation and tests may proceed before the choice; arming may not.

Guardrails for all code work: work only in a linked worktree (make worktree-create); never edit the primary clone. No explanatory comments or docstrings in source (make comment-policy-check). Durations use benchbox.utils.clock.mono_time()/elapsed_seconds(). Add a changelog.d/ fragment. Cited line numbers are orientation only: re-read the named symbols, docs and spec clauses before editing and treat a mismatch as a reason to stop and update this item. No live-cloud runs without owner approval; heavy runs only through make heavy-run or a lock-taking entry point. Green focused tests are not release certification. The text executed must be byte-identical to today's for the same seed, stream and dialect (power_stream_seed unchanged). A generation error must still abort the run before the first query is timed (preflight semantics). Generation time is not added to any metric input. Do not edit the perf-smoke baseline here; perf-smoke-rebaseline-after-power-query-generation-20261103 owns it.
